draft_en.subject: Ethernet converters and small industrial switches in the Bit-Driver catalogue - a second source
draft_en.body:
Hi Ramesh,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "16 Port Industrial PoE Switch" on 10 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Serial modems and multiplexers are yours; for the Ethernet media converters and small industrial switches in the Bit-Driver catalogue, a second source in your housing from small lots, -40 to 75 C, FCC/CE/RoHS: industrial Gigabit converter, 1 x RJ45 + 1 x SFP slot (fixed SC optional) - model STI-110GE - $26.5 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); DIN-rail 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged - STI-280GE - $46; 8 x PoE+ + 2 x SFP - STI-288GP - $62.2.

One question: which Ethernet model do your SCADA customers order most?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
